title: crepidomanes humile
intro: Crepidomanes humile, commonly known as the dwarf climbing fern, is a species of epiphytic fern that belongs to the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
